entries.description: Puts the agent you already run inside a live Google Meet or Zoom call: it reads the on-screen captions and answers in a side panel while people are still talking.
representativeQueries: how do I get my AI agent to help me during a live meeting
MCP server that reads a Google Meet or Zoom transcript in real time
meeting assistant that runs locally and does not join the call as a bot
AI notetaker alternative that uses my own Claude Code session instead of a hosted model
how do I let an agent see what is being said in a call without sending it to a vendor
